newsitem.title: MEXICO: Farben issues $50 mln in convertible debt.
newsitem.headline: Farben issues $50 mln in convertible debt.

text.p: Mexican retailer Farmacias Benavides SA (Farben) has placed the equivalent of $50 million in inflation-indexed debt convertible to shares, lead manager Bancomer brokerage said.
The debt has a maturity of five years and is denominated in UDIs, inflation-linked instruments, Bancomer said in a statement.
The debt's maturity is divided into 22 periods of 84 days each. At the end of each period, the notes will pay a return of five percent in real terms.
At the end of the fifth period, investors will have the option to keep the debt or swap it for equity in the company, Mexico's largest chain of pharmacy stores.
Through the issue, Bevides will transfer debt from a floating rate to a fixed real rate and will use the money as part of its investment program, Bancomer said.
Bancomer is a unit of Grupo Financiero Bancomer SA .
